active_rule: active = levels whose shell is in Sr 4s, Sr 4p, Sr 5s, Sr 4d, Ti 3d, Ti 4s, Ti 4p, O 2s, O 2p AND not a point-charge-site state; no pruning (missing dimensions come from the SMV disentanglement); only as a last resort, while lambda_min(G) <= reg_tol in the model space, the lowest-W level group in the null space of G is removed
